payload.title: Live numbers for static sites: scheduled snapshots and client components
payload.description:
Static Papyrus sites publish pages, not live data, and nothing in a site runs on a schedule today. High-churn numbers (board ranks, vote counts, rising items) must be JSON that a small client component reads, refreshed by a scheduled job, with a visible "updated N min ago".

Parent initiative: PPY-77bb3b (milestone 6). Shares the snapshot mechanism with the public knowledge base initiative PPY-428252 (knowledge snapshot command). New scheduled compute or schedules need explicit human approval before creation.

Children: scheduled board snapshot job; client components and freshness label.
Definition of Done: a pilot site shows a ranked board, counts and a rising list from snapshot JSON that refreshes on a schedule.
